title: When the Crown Sings
author: Ulyana Thackeray
blurb: Dominic Vane, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
